MINUTES OF AN ADJOURNED MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE HELD IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  OF THE LA VERNE CITY HALL
  Tuesday, June 25, 2019
  Continuation of Planning Commission Applicants Interviews)

 1.
  An adjourned meeting of the La Verne City Council was called to order by Mayor Kendrick at 2: 00 p. m.
 2.  Council Members present:  Mayor pon Kendrick
  Mayor Pro Tem Charlie Rosales
  Council Member Robin Carder
  Council Member Muir Davis
  Council Member Tim Hepburn

  Absent:  None.

  Advisory personnel  present:  City Manager Robert Russi
  City Attorney Robert L. Kress
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer

3.
  Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Kendrick.
4.  Continued -  Planning  Continued from June 24th adjourned meeting, Planning Commission
  Commission Applicant  Interviews.
  At its adjourned meeting of June 17, 2019, the City Council heard
  Interviews  from the Planning Commission Applicants who gave a three ( 3) minute
  presentation  for the two vacancies  on  the Planning Commission.  After the
  presentation  City Council selected  10 applicants for interview.  The City
  Council interviewed the last five applicants, as follows:

  Alex Chakmak
  Thomas Skahill
  Jason Lorge
  David Saldana
  Raymond  Herbert

  After interviews, it was the consensus of the City Council to appoint Jeffry
  Allred and Jason Lorge to the Planning Commission and Thomas Allison as
  alternate.

  Formal Appointment of the two ( 2) new Planning Commissioners will be at the
  July 15, 2019, City Council Meeting.
5.  Public Comment
  This was the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the City Council on
  items not listed in any other  place  on  the agenda.  Mayor Kendrick called for
  public  comment.

  There was none.
6..  Adjournment at 4: 15 pm.

  Res  ectfull  ted,

  Bob Russi, City Manager
